item.tech_tweaks.virtual_link_cutter.des: Right-click both wire or pipe endpoints to cut their virtual link. Sneak-right-click to cancel.
message.tech_tweaks.link_mismatch: Select two wire endpoints or two pipe endpoints in the same dimension. Please start again.
message.tech_tweaks.link_unavailable: The first endpoint was removed, is unloaded, or cannot be edited. Please start again.
message.tech_tweaks.link_missing: There is no virtual link between these endpoints.
